e: Adonoy spoke to Moshe saying.

h: פִּֽינְחָ֨ס בֶּן־אֶלְעָזָ֜ר בֶּן־אַהֲרֹ֣ן הַכֹּהֵ֗ן הֵשִׁ֤יב אֶת־חֲמָתִי֙ מֵעַ֣ל בְּנֵֽי־יִשְׂרָאֵ֔ל
t: פִּינְחָס בַּר אֶלְעָזָר בַּר אַהֲרֹן כַּהֲנָא אֲתֵב יָת חֵימְתִי מֵעַל בְּנֵי יִשְׂרָאֵל
וְלָא שֵׁיצֵיתִי יָת בְּנֵי יִשְׂרָאֵל בְּקִנְאָתִי:
e: “Pinchas, the son of Elozor, [and grand] son of Aharon the kohein, has turned My anger away from Bnei Yisroel
by his vengeance for Me among them,
so that I did not destroy Bnei Yisroel in My vengeance.

t: הָא אֲנָא גְזַר לֵיהּ יָת קְיָמִי שְׁלָם:
e: Therefore tell [him],
that I give [decree for] him My covenant [of] peace.
It shall be for him and his descendants after him
a covenant of eternal kehunah
because he was zealous for [before] his God
and made atonement for Bnei Yisroel.”

h: וְשֵׁם֩ אִ֨ישׁ יִשְׂרָאֵ֜ל הַמֻּכֶּ֗ה אֲשֶׁ֤ר הֻכָּה֙ אֶת־הַמִּדְיָנִ֔ית
t: וְשׁוּם גַּבְרָא בַר יִשְׂרָאֵל קְטִילָא דִּי אִתְקְטֵל עִם מִדְיָנֵיתָא
e: The name of the slain Israelite man, who was killed along with the Midianite woman,
was Zimri, son of Salu,
leader of a paternal house of Shimon.

h: וְשֵׁ֨ם הָֽאִשָּׁ֧ה הַמֻּכָּ֛ה הַמִּדְיָנִ֖ית כָּזְבִּ֣י בַת־צ֑וּר
t: וְשׁוּם אִתְּתָא דְאִתְקְטִילַת מִדְיָנֵתָא כָּזְבִּי בַת צוּר
רֵישׁ אֻמֵּי בֵּית אַבָּא בְּמִדְיָן הוּא:
e: The name of the slain Midianite woman was Kozbi, daughter of Tzur,
the national leader of a paternal house in Midian.
Adonoy spoke to Moshe saying:
“Antagonize the Midianites
and kill them,

t: בְּנִכְלֵיהוֹן דִּי נְכִילוּ לְכוֹן עַל עֵסַק פְּעוֹר
וְעַל עֵסַק כָּזְבִּי בַת רַבָּא דְמִדְיָן אֲחַתְהוֹן
דְּאִתְקְטִילַת בְּיוֹמָא דְמוֹתָנָא עַל עֵסַק פְּעוֹר:
e: for they antagonized you
with their guiles in the matter of Pe’or,
and in the matter of Kozbi the daughter of a Midianite prince, their sister,
who was killed on the day of the plague that resulted from Pe’or.”
It was after the plague.
Adonoy spoke to Moshe
and Elozor, son of Aharon the kohein, saying:

h: שְׂא֞וּ אֶת־רֹ֣אשׁ כָּל־עֲדַ֣ת בְּנֵי־יִשְׂרָאֵ֗ל מִבֶּ֨ן עֶשְׂרִ֥ים שָׁנָ֛ה וָמַ֖עְלָה לְבֵ֣ית אֲבֹתָ֑ם
t: קַבִּילוּ יָת חֻשְׁבַּן כָּל כְּנִשְׁתָּא דִבְנֵי יִשְׂרָאֵל מִבַּר עַשְׂרִין שְׁנִין וּלְעֵלָּא לְבֵית אֲבָהַתְהוֹן
e: “[Take the] count [of] the whole community of Bnei Yisroel twenty years of age and above, according to their paternal house,
every one who is fit for duty in the army of Yisroel.”

h: וַיְדַבֵּ֨ר מֹשֶׁ֜ה וְאֶלְעָזָ֧ר הַכֹּהֵ֛ן אֹתָ֖ם בְּעַֽרְבֹ֣ת מוֹאָ֑ב
t: וּמַלִּיל משֶׁה וְאֶלְעָזָר כַּהֲנָא אֲמָרוּ לְמִמְנֵי יָתְהוֹן בְּמֵישְׁרַיָּא דְמוֹאָב
e: Moshe and Elozor the kohein spoke with [to count] them on the plains of Moav,
by the Yardein near Yereicho, saying:

h: כַּאֲשֶׁר֩ צִוָּ֨ה יְהוָ֤ה אֶת־מֹשֶׁה֙ וּבְנֵ֣י יִשְׂרָאֵ֔ל
t: כְּמָא דִי פַקִּיד יְיָ יָת משֶׁה וּבְנֵי יִשְׂרָאֵל דִּי
e: “[Count those] twenty years of age and above,
as Adonoy commanded Moshe and Bnei Yisroel
who had left Egypt.”
Reuvein, [was] Yisroel’s firstborn;
the descendants of Reuvein are: the Chanochite family from Chanoch,
the Paluite family from Palu,
the Chetzronite family from Chetzron
and the Karmite family from Karmi.
These are Reuvein’s families
and they numbered forty-three thousand,
and seven hundred and thirty.
Palu’s son[s were] was Eliav.

h: הֽוּא־דָתָ֨ן וַאֲבִירָ֜ם קרואי [קְרִיאֵ֣י] הָעֵדָ֗ה אֲשֶׁ֨ר הִצּ֜וּ עַל־מֹשֶׁ֤ה וְעַֽל־אַהֲרֹן֙ בַּעֲדַת־קֹ֔רַח
t: הוּא דָתָן וַאֲבִירָם מְעַרְעֵי כְנִשְׁתָּא דְּאִתְכְּנָשׁוּ עַל משֶׁה וְעַל אַהֲרֹן בִּכְנִשְׁתָּא דְקֹרַח
e: Eliav’s sons were
Nemueil, Dasan and Aviram.
They are Dasan and Aviram, the communal leaders, who incited against Moshe and Aharon in the assembly of Korach
when they incited against Adonoy.

h: וַתִּפְתַּ֨ח הָאָ֜רֶץ אֶת־פִּ֗יהָ וַתִּבְלַ֥ע אֹתָ֛ם וְאֶת־קֹ֖רַח בְּמ֣וֹת הָעֵדָ֑ה
בַּאֲכֹ֣ל הָאֵ֗שׁ אֵ֣ת חֲמִשִּׁ֤ים וּמָאתַ֙יִם֙ אִ֔ישׁ
t: וּפְתָחַת אַרְעָא יָת פּוּמָהּ וּבְלָעַת יָתְהוֹן וְיָת קֹרַח בְּמוֹתָא דִכְנִשְׁתָּא
כַּד אֲכָלַת אֶשָּׁתָא יָת מָאתָן וְחַמְשִׁין גַּבְרָא
e: The earth opened its mouth and swallowed them and Korach when that assembly died;
when fire consumed the two hundred and fifty men;
they became a symbol.
But the sons of Korach did not die.
The descendants of Shimon by their families are:
the Nemuelite family from Nemuel,
the Yaminite family from Yamin,
the Yachinite family from Yachin,
the Zarchite family from Zerach,
[and] the Shaulite family from Shaul.
These are the families of Shimon
— twenty- two thousand and two hundred.
The descendants of Gad by their families are:
The Tzefonite family from Tzefon,
the Chagite family from Chagi,
the Shunite family from Shuni,
the Oznite family from Ozni,
the Eirite family from Eiri,
the Arodite family from Arod,
and the Areilite family from Areili.
These are the families of Gad’s descendants
and they numbered forty thousand and five hundred.
The sons of Yehudah are Eir and Onan;
Eir and Onan died in the land of Canaan.
The descendants of Yehudah by their families are:
The Sheilanite family from Sheila,
the Partzite family from Peretz,
the Zarchite family from Zerach.
The descendants of Peretz were:
The Chetzronite family from Chetzron,
and the Chamulite family from Chamul.
These are the families of Yehudah
and they numbered seventy-six thousand and five hundred.
The descendants of Yissachar by their families are:
The Tolaite family from Tola,
the Punite family from Puva,
the Yashuvite family from Yashuv,
and the Shimronite family from Shimron.
These are the families of Yissachar
and they numbered sixty-four thousand and three hundred.
The descendants of Zevulun by their families are:
The Sardite family from Sered,
the Eilonite family from Eilon,
[and] the Yachle’eilite family from Yachle’eil.
These are the families of Zevulun
and they numbered sixty thousand and five hundred.
The descendants of Yoseif by their families are:
Menashe and Ephraim.
The descendants of Menashe are: The Machirite family from Machir;
Machir’s son was Gil’ad,
the Gil’adite family from Gil’ad.
The descendants of Gil’ad are:
The I’ezerite family from I’ezer,
the Chelkite family from Cheilek,
the Asrieilite family from Asrieil,
the Shechemite family from Shechem,
the Shemidaite family from Shemida,
and the Chefrite family from Cheifer.

h: וּצְלָפְחָ֣ד בֶּן־חֵ֗פֶר לֹא־הָ֥יוּ ל֛וֹ בָּנִ֖ים כִּ֣י אִם־בָּנ֑וֹת
t: וּצְלָפְחָד בַּר חֵפֶר לָא הֲווֹ לֵיהּ בְּנִין אֶלָּהֵן בְּנָן
e: Tzelofchad the son of Cheifer had no sons, only daughters;
The name[s] of Tzelofchad’s daughters were
Machlah, No’ah,
Choglah, Milkah and Sirtzah.

h: וּפְקֻ֣דֵיהֶ֔ם שְׁנַ֧יִם וַחֲמִשִּׁ֛ים אֶ֖לֶף וּשְׁבַ֥ע מֵאֽוֹת׃
t: וּמִנְיָנֵיהוֹן חַמְשִׁין וּתְרֵין אַלְפִין וּשְׁבַע מְאָה:
e: These are the families of Menashe
and they numbered fifty-two thousand and seven hundred.
The descendants of Ephraim by their families are:
The Shusalchite family from Shuselach,
the Bachrite family from Becher,
and the Tachanite family from Tachan.
These are the sons of Shuselach:
The Eiranite family from Eiran.
These are the families of Ephraim’s descendants,
and they numbered thirty-two thousand and five hundred;
these are the descendants of Yoseif by their families.
The descendants of Binyamin by their families were:
The Balite family from Bela,
the Ashbelite family from Ashbeil,
the Achiramite family from Achiram,
the Shufamite family from Shfufam,
and the Chufamite family from Chufam.
The sons of Bela were Ard and Na’aman
[giving rise to] the Ardite family, and
the Na’amite family from Na’aman.

h: וּפְקֻ֣דֵיהֶ֔ם חֲמִשָּׁ֧ה וְאַרְבָּעִ֛ים אֶ֖לֶף וְשֵׁ֥שׁ מֵאֽוֹת׃
t: וּמִנְיָנֵיהוֹן אַרְבְּעִין וְחַמְשָׁא אַלְפִין וְשִׁית מְאָה:
e: These are the descendants of Binyamin by their families,
and they numbered forty-five thousand and six hundred.
These are the descendants of Don by their families:
The Shuchamite family from Shucham,
these are Don’s families.
All Shuchamite families numbered
sixty-four thousand and four hundred.
The descendants of Asher by their families are:
The Yimnite family from Yimnah,
the Yishvite family from Yishvi,
[and] the Bri’ite family from Briah .
The descendants of Briah are:
The Chevronite family from Chever,
the Malkieilite family from Malkieil.
The name of Asher’s daughter was Serach.
These are the families of Asher
and they numbered fifty-three thousand and four hundred.
The descendants of Naftali by their families are:
the Yachtze’eilite family from Yachtze’eil,
the Gunite family from Guni,
the Yitzrite family from Yeitzer,
and the Shileimite family from Shileim.

h: וּפְקֻ֣דֵיהֶ֔ם חֲמִשָּׁ֧ה וְאַרְבָּעִ֛ים אֶ֖לֶף וְאַרְבַּ֥ע מֵאֽוֹת׃
t: וּמִנְיָנֵיהוֹן אַרְבְּעִין וְחַמְשָׁא אַלְפִין וְאַרְבַּע מְאָה:
e: These are the families of Nafatli
and they numbered forty-five thousand and four hundred.
The total number of Bnei Yisroel
was six hundred and one thousand,
seven hundred and thirty.
Adonoy spoke to Moshe saying.

h: לָאֵ֗לֶּה תֵּחָלֵ֥ק הָאָ֛רֶץ בְּנַחֲלָ֖ה בְּמִסְפַּ֥ר שֵׁמֽוֹת׃
t: לְאִלֵּין תִּתְפְּלֵג אַרְעָא בְּאַחֲסָנָא בְּמִנְיַן שְׁמָהָן:
e: “The land shall be apportioned among these, as an inheritance according to the number of names.
To the large [tribe], increase their inheritance,
and to the small, diminish their inheritance;
each person, according to his number,
shall be given his inheritance.
Only by lot should the land be divided,
according to the names of their fathers’ tribes should they inherit it.
By word of the lottery
should their inheritance be divided,
with regard to whether they are many or few.”
These are the numbered ones of the Levites by their families:
The Gershonite family of Gershon,
the Kehosite family of Kehos,
[and] the Merorite family of Merori.

h: אֵ֣לֶּה מִשְׁפְּחֹ֣ת לֵוִ֗י מִשְׁפַּ֨חַת הַלִּבְנִ֜י מִשְׁפַּ֤חַת הַֽחֶבְרֹנִי֙ מִשְׁפַּ֤חַת הַמַּחְלִי֙ מִשְׁפַּ֣חַת הַמּוּשִׁ֔י
t: אִלֵּין זַרְעֲיַת לֵוִי זַרְעִית לִבְנִי זַרְעִית חֶבְרוֹן זַרְעִית מַחְלִי זַרְעִית מוּשִׁי
e: These are the families of Levi: the Livnite family, the Chevronite family, the Machlite family, the Mushite family,
and the Korchite family;
Kehos’ son was Amram.

t: וְשׁוּם אִתַּת עַמְרָם יוֹכֶבֶד בַּת לֵוִי
וִילֵדַת לְעַמְרָם יָת אַהֲרֹן וְיָת משֶׁה
e: The name of Amram’s wife was Yocheved,
daughter of Levi, whom [her mother] bore to Levi in Egypt.
She bore to Amram, Aharon, Moshe,
and their sister Miriam.
To Aharon were borne,
Nadav and Avihu,
Elozor and Isamar.
Nadav and Avihu died
when they offered a forbidden fire before Adonoy.

h: כִּ֣י לֹ֣א הָתְפָּקְד֗וּ בְּתוֹךְ֙ בְּנֵ֣י יִשְׂרָאֵ֔ל
t: אֲרֵי לָא אִתְמְנִיאוּ בְּגוֹ בְנֵי יִשְׂרָאֵל
e: They numbered twenty-three thousand,
for all males from one month and older.
They were not counted among Bnei Yisroel,
since no inheritance was given to them
among Bnei Yisroel.

h: אֲשֶׁ֨ר פָּֽקְד֜וּ אֶת־בְּנֵ֤י יִשְׂרָאֵל֙ בְּעַֽרְבֹ֣ת מוֹאָ֔ב
t: דִּי מְנוֹ יָת בְּנֵי יִשְׂרָאֵל בְּמֵישְׁרַיָּא דְמוֹאָב
e: This is the census of Moshe
and Elozor the kohein
who counted the Bnei Yisroel in the plains of Moav,
at Yardein Yereicho.

h: אֲשֶׁ֥ר פָּקְד֛וּ אֶת־בְּנֵ֥י יִשְׂרָאֵ֖ל בְּמִדְבַּ֥ר סִינָֽי׃
t: דִּי מְנוֹ יָת בְּנֵי יִשְׂרָאֵל בְּמַדְבְּרָא דְסִינָי:
e: Among this [census] there was no man who
had been included in the census of Moshe
and Aharon the kohein,
who had counted Bnei Yisroel in the wilderness of Sinai,
because Adonoy said to them that
they would die in the desert.
No one was left
with the exception of Kaleiv, son of Yefuneh
and Yehoshua, son of Nun.

h: וַתִּקְרַ֜בְנָה בְּנ֣וֹת צְלָפְחָ֗ד בֶּן־חֵ֤פֶר בֶּן־גִּלְעָד֙ בֶּן־מָכִ֣יר בֶּן־מְנַשֶּׁ֔ה
t: וְקָרֵיבָא בְּנַת צְלָפְחָד בַּר חֵפֶר בַּר גִּלְעָד בַּר מָכִיר בַּר מְנַשֶּׁה
e: And they approached — the daughters of Tzelofchad, son of Cheifer, son of Gil’ad, son of Machir, son of Menashe,
of the families of Menashe the son of Yoseif.
The names of his daughters were:
Machlah, No’ah,
Choglah, Milkah and Sirtzah.

h: וַֽתַּעֲמֹ֜דְנָה לִפְנֵ֣י מֹשֶׁ֗ה וְלִפְנֵי֙ אֶלְעָזָ֣ר הַכֹּהֵ֔ן
t: וְקָמָא קֳדָם משֶׁה וְקֳדָם אֶלְעָזָר כַּהֲנָא
e: They stood before Moshe and before Elozor the kohein,
and before the princes, and the entire community
at the Tent of Meeting entrance, saying:

h: וְה֨וּא לֹא־הָיָ֜ה בְּת֣וֹךְ הָעֵדָ֗ה הַנּוֹעָדִ֛ים עַל־יְהוָ֖ה בַּעֲדַת־קֹ֑רַח
t: וְהוּא לָא הֲוָה בְּגוֹ כְנִשְׁתָּא דְּאִזְדַּמָּנוּ עַל יְיָ בִּכְנִשְׁתָּא דְקֹרַח
e: “Our father died in the wilderness,
but he was not among the group that banded together against Adonoy, in the company of Korach,
but he died because of his own sin
without leaving any sons.
Why should the name of our father be omitted [held back] from his family
because he did not have a son?
Give us a possession [of land]
among our father’s brothers.”

t: וְקָרֵב משֶׁה יָת דִּינְהֶן קֳדָם יְיָ:
e: Moshe brought their case before Adonoy.
Adonoy spoke to Moshe saying:
“Tzelofchad’s daughters speak justly,
give them a hereditary portion of land
among their father’s brothers,
and transfer the inheritance of their father to them.

t: גְּבַר אֲרֵי יְמוּת וּבַר לֵית לֵיהּ
e: Speak to Bnei Yisroel and tell them,
that if a man dies and has no son,
his hereditary property shall be transferred to his daughter.
If he has no daughter,
you shall give his hereditary property to his brothers.
If he has no brothers,
you shall give his hereditary property to his father’s brothers.

h: וּנְתַתֶּ֣ם אֶת־נַחֲלָת֗וֹ לִשְׁאֵר֞וֹ הַקָּרֹ֥ב אֵלָ֛יו מִמִּשְׁפַּחְתּ֖וֹ וְיָרַ֣שׁ אֹתָ֑הּ
t: וְתִתְּנוּן יָת אַחֲסַנְתֵּיהּ לְקָרִיבֵיהּ דְּקָרִיב לֵיהּ מִזַּרְעִיתֵיהּ וְיֵרַת יָתַהּ
כְּמָא דִי פַּקִּיד יְיָ יָת משֶׁה:
e: If his father had no brothers,
you shall give his hereditary property to the relative closest to him in his family who will then inherit it.
This shall remain a decreed law for Bnei Yisroel,
as Adonoy had commanded Moshe.”
Adonoy said to Moshe:
“Go up this Avarim Mountain
and look at the land
that I have given to Bnei Yisroel.
[After] you have seen it,
you too will be gathered to your people,
just as your brother Aharon was gathered.

h: כַּאֲשֶׁר֩ מְרִיתֶ֨ם פִּ֜י בְּמִדְבַּר־צִ֗ן בִּמְרִיבַת֙ הָֽעֵדָ֔ה
t: כְּמָא דִי סָרֵיבְתּוּן עַל מֵימְרִי בְּמַדְבְּרָא דְצִן בְּמַצּוּת כְּנִשְׁתָּא
e: Because you disobeyed My words in the wilderness of Tzin, when the community quarreled,
[you were] to sanctify Me through the water, before their eyes.”
Those were the waters of dispute at Kadeish [Rekam], in the wilderness of Tzin.
Moshe spoke
to Adonoy, saying:
“Let Adonoy,
God of the spirits,
appoint a man over the community,

t: דִּי יִפּוֹק קֳדָמֵיהוֹן וְדִי יֵעוֹל קֳדָמֵיהוֹן
e: who will go forth before them, and who will come back before them,
and who would lead them out and bring them in,
so that the community of Adonoy shall not be
like sheep that have no shepherd.”

h: וַיֹּ֨אמֶר יְהוָ֜ה אֶל־מֹשֶׁ֗ה קַח־לְךָ֙ אֶת־יְהוֹשֻׁ֣עַ בִּן־נ֔וּן
t: וַאֲמַר יְיָ לְמשֶׁה דְבַר לָךְ יָת יְהוֹשֻׁע בַּר נוּן
e: Adonoy said to Moshe: “Take to yourself Yehoshua son of Nun,
a man in whom there is spirit [of prophecy],
and lay your hand on him.
Stand him before Elozor the kohein
and before the entire community,
and command him before their eyes.

t: בְּדִיל דִּי יְקַבְּלוּן מִנֵּיהּ כָּל כְּנִשְׁתָּא דִּבְנֵי יִשְׂרָאֵל:
e: Bestow some of your radiance on him,
so that the entire community of Bnei Yisroel will hear [be receptive to him].

h: וְשָׁ֥אַל ל֛וֹ בְּמִשְׁפַּ֥ט הָאוּרִ֖ים לִפְנֵ֣י יְהוָ֑ה
עַל־פִּ֨יו יֵצְא֜וּ וְעַל־פִּ֣יו יָבֹ֗אוּ ה֛וּא וְכָל־בְּנֵי־יִשְׂרָאֵ֥ל אִתּ֖וֹ וְכָל־הָעֵדָֽה׃
t: וְיִשְׁאַל לֵיהּ בְּדִין אוּרַיָּא קֳדָם יְיָ
עַל מֵימְרֵיהּ יְהוֹן נָפְקִין וְעַל מֵימְרֵיהּ יְהוֹן עַלִּין הוּא וְכָל בְּנֵי יִשְׂרָאֵל עִמֵּיהּ וְכָל כְּנִשְׁתָּא:
e: He shall stand before Elozor the kohein,
and ask, of him, through the judgment of the Urim before Adonoy.
By his word they will come out and [by his word they will] go in — he, all Bnei Yisroel with him, and the entire community.”

h: וַיִּקַּ֣ח אֶת־יְהוֹשֻׁ֗עַ וַיַּֽעֲמִדֵ֙הוּ֙ לִפְנֵי֙ אֶלְעָזָ֣ר הַכֹּהֵ֔ן
t: וּדְבַר יָת יְהוֹשֻׁעַ וַאֲקִימֵיהּ קֳדָם אֶלְעָזָר כַּהֲנָא
e: Moshe did
as Adonoy commanded him.
He took Yehoshua and presented him to Elozor the kohein
and to the entire community.

t: כְּמָא דִי מַלִּיל יְיָ בִּידָא דְמשֶׁה:
e: He laid his hands on him and commanded him,
just as Adonoy had commanded through Moshe.
Adonoy spoke to Moshe saying:
“Command Bnei Yisroel
and say to them,
‘My offering, My food of [prepared for] My fires, a pleasing aroma [to be accepted willingly] to Me,
you shall be vigilant to offer to [before] Me at its prescribed time’.”

h: כְּבָשִׂ֨ים בְּנֵֽי־שָׁנָ֧ה תְמִימִ֛ם שְׁנַ֥יִם לַיּ֖וֹם עֹלָ֥ה תָמִֽיד׃
t: אִמְּרִין בְּנֵי שְׁנָא שַׁלְמִין תְּרֵין לְיוֹמָא עֲלָתָא תְדִירָא:
e: Say to them:
“This is the fire-offering
that you shall offer to Adonoy;
yearling lambs without blemish, two each day, as a constant (daily) burnt-offering.

h: וְאֵת֙ הַכֶּ֣בֶשׂ הַשֵּׁנִ֔י תַּעֲשֶׂ֖ה בֵּ֥ין הָֽעַרְבָּֽיִם׃
t: וְיָת אִמְּרָא תִנְיָנָא תַּעֲבֵּד בֵּין שִׁמְשַׁיָּא:
e: Offer one lamb in the morning
and offer the second lamb in the afternoon.

t: וְחַד מִן עַשְׂרָא בִּתְלַת סְאִין סוּלְתָּא לְמִנְחָתָא
e: And one tenth of an eiphah [three se’in] of fine flour as a meal-offering,
mixed with beaten oil measuring one fourth of a hin.
[This is] a constant (daily) burnt-offering
as offered on Mount Sinai,
for a pleasing aroma [to be accepted willingly],
a fire-offering to [before] Adonoy.

t: בְּקוּדְשָׁא יִתְנַסַּךְ נִסּוּךְ דַּחֲמַר עַתִּיק קֳדָם יְיָ:
e: Its libation [shall be] one fourth of a hin
for the one lamb,
in the Holy [Sanctuary], you shall pour an intoxicating libation [of aged wine] to [before] Adonoy.
Offer the second lamb
in the afternoon,
with the same meal-offering of the morning together with its libation you shall offer it,
a fire-offering of a pleasing aroma [accepted willingly] to [before] Adonoy.

h: וּשְׁנֵ֣י עֶשְׂרֹנִ֗ים סֹ֧לֶת מִנְחָ֛ה בְּלוּלָ֥ה בַשֶּׁ֖מֶן וְנִסְכּֽוֹ׃
t: וּתְרֵין עִשְׂרוֹנִין סוּלְתָּא דְמִנְחָתָא דְּפִילָא בִמְשַׁח וְנִסְכֵּיהּ:
e: On the Shabbos day
[the offering shall be] two yearling lambs without blemish,
and two tenths [of an eiphah] of fine flour as a meal-offering, mixed with [olive] oil, and its libation.
This is the burnt-offering on its [which is done on] Shabbos,
in addition to the constant (daily) burnt-offering and its libation.

t: תּוֹרִין בְּנֵי תוֹרֵי תְּרֵין וּדְכַר חַד
e: At the beginning of your months
you shall bring a burnt-offering to Adonoy,
two young bulls, one ram,
seven yearling lambs, [all] without blemish.

h: וּשְׁלֹשָׁ֣ה עֶשְׂרֹנִ֗ים סֹ֤לֶת מִנְחָה֙ בְּלוּלָ֣ה בַשֶּׁ֔מֶן
וּשְׁנֵ֣י עֶשְׂרֹנִ֗ים סֹ֤לֶת מִנְחָה֙ בְּלוּלָ֣ה בַשֶּׁ֔מֶן
t: וּתְלָתָא עִשְׂרוֹנִין סוּלְתָּא מִנְחָתָא דְּפִילָא בִמְשַׁח
וּתְרֵין עִשְׂרוֹנִין סוּלְתָּא מִנְחָתָא דְּפִילָא בִמְשַׁח
e: And three tenths [of an eiphah] of fine flour as a meal-offering mixed with the [olive] oil
for each bull,
two tenths [of an eiphah] of fine flour as a meal-offering, mixed with the [olive] oil
for the one ram,

h: וְעִשָּׂרֹ֣ן עִשָּׂר֗וֹן סֹ֤לֶת מִנְחָה֙ בְּלוּלָ֣ה בַשֶּׁ֔מֶן
t: וְעִשְׂרוֹנָא עִשְׂרוֹנָא סֻלְתָּא מִנְחָתָא דְּפִילָא בִמְשַׁח
e: And one tenth [of an eiphah] of fine flour as a meal-offering mixed with the [olive] oil
for each lamb.
A burnt-offering of pleasing aroma,
a fire-offering [accepted willingly] to [before] Adonoy.

h: וְנִסְכֵּיהֶ֗ם חֲצִ֣י הַהִין֩ יִהְיֶ֨ה לַפָּ֜ר וּשְׁלִישִׁ֧ת הַהִ֣ין לָאַ֗יִל וּרְבִיעִ֥ת הַהִ֛ין לַכֶּ֖בֶשׂ יָ֑יִן
t: וְנִסְכֵּיהוֹן פַּלְגּוּת הִינָא יְהֵי לְתוֹרָא וְתַלְתּוּת הִינָא לְדִכְרָא וְרַבְעוּת הִינָא לְאִמְּרָא חַמְרָא
e: Their libations [shall be], one half of a hin for (a) bull, one third of a hin for the ram, and one fourth of a hin for (the) lamb, of wine.
This is the burnt-offering of each [Rosh] Chodesh [new moon], at its renewal
throughout [thus all] the months [new months] of the year.

t: וּצְפִיר בַּר עִזֵּי חַד לְחַטָּאתָא קֳדָם יְיָ
e: And [You shall also bring] one he-goat for a sin offering to Adonoy,
in addition to the constant (daily) burnt-offering it shall be done, and its libation.

h: וּבַחֹ֣דֶשׁ הָרִאשׁ֗וֹן בְּאַרְבָּעָ֥ה עָשָׂ֛ר י֖וֹם לַחֹ֑דֶשׁ
t: וּבְיַרְחָא קַדְמָאָה בְּאַרְבַּעַת עַשְׂרָא יוֹמָא לְיַרְחָא
e: In the first month — on the fourteenth day of the month [bring a]
Pesach [offering] to [before] Adonoy.

h: וּבַחֲמִשָּׁ֨ה עָשָׂ֥ר י֛וֹם לַחֹ֥דֶשׁ הַזֶּ֖ה חָ֑ג
t: וּבְחַמְשַׁת עַשְׂרָא יוֹמָא לְיַרְחָא הָדֵין חַגָּא
e: The fifteenth day of that month is a festival,
matzohs shall be eaten for seven days.
The first day shall be a sacred holiday,
any work of consequence you must not do.

t: תּוֹרִין בְּנֵי תוֹרֵי תְּרֵין וּדְכַר חַד
e: You shall bring a burnt fire-offering to [before] Adonoy [consisting of]
two young bulls, one ram,
and seven yearling sheep.
They shall [all] be without blemish.

h: שְׁלֹשָׁ֨ה עֶשְׂרֹנִ֜ים לַפָּ֗ר וּשְׁנֵ֧י עֶשְׂרֹנִ֛ים לָאַ֖יִל תַּעֲשֽׂוּ׃
t: תְּלָתָא עִשְׂרוֹנִין לְתוֹרָא וּתְרֵין עִשְׂרוֹנִין לְדִכְרָא תַּעְבְּדוּן:
e: Their meal-offering shall be fine flour mixed with [olive] oil,
three tenths [of an eiphah] for each bull, two tenths [of an eiphah] for the ram,
and one tenth [of an eiphah] [thus]
for each
of the seven sheep.
[You should also bring] one he-goat as a sin-offering,
to make atonement for you,
in addition to the morning burnt-offering
which is offered as a constant (daily) burnt-offering,
you shall make these.
Like these, you shall make daily for seven days,
food as a fire-offering of a pleasing aroma [accepted willingly] to [before] Adonoy,
(it shall be offered) in addition to the constant (daily) burnt-offering and its libation.
The seventh day
shall be a sacred holiday to you,
when you shall not do any work of consequence.

h: וּבְי֣וֹם הַבִּכּוּרִ֗ים בְּהַקְרִ֨יבְכֶ֜ם מִנְחָ֤ה חֲדָשָׁה֙ לַֽיהוָ֔ה בְּשָׁבֻעֹ֖תֵיכֶ֑ם
t: וּבְיוֹמָא דְבִכּוּרַיָּא בְּקָרוֹבֵיכוֹן מִנְחֲתָא חֲדַתָּא קֳדָם יְיָ בְּעַצְרָתֵיכוֹן
e: On the day of the first fruits when you bring a new meal-offering to Adonoy on your Festival of Weeks,
there shall be a sacred holiday to you
when you shall not do any work of consequence.

t: תּוֹרִין בְּנֵי תוֹרֵי תְּרֵין וּדְכַר חַד
e: You shall make a burnt-offering of a pleasing aroma [accepted willingly] to [before] Adonoy [consisting of]
two young bulls, one ram, [and]
seven yearling lambs.
Their meal-offering [shall be] fine flour mixed with [olive] oil,
three tenths [of an eiphah] for each bull,
two tenths [of an eiphah]
for the one ram,
and one tenth [of an eiphah]
for each
of the seven lambs.
[You should also bring] one he-goat
to make atonement for you,
in addition to bringing the constant (daily) burnt-offering and its meal- offering.
[The sacrifices] shall be without blemish — and their libations.

h: וּבַחֹ֨דֶשׁ הַשְּׁבִיעִ֜י בְּאֶחָ֣ד לַחֹ֗דֶשׁ מִֽקְרָא־קֹ֙דֶשׁ֙ יִהְיֶ֣ה לָכֶ֔ם
t: וּבְיַרְחָא שְׁבִיעָאָה בְּחַד לְיַרְחָא מְעָרַע קַדִּישׁ יְהֵי לְכוֹן
e: The first day of the seventh month shall be a sacred holiday to you
when you shall not do any work of consequence.
It shall be a day of sounding the ram’s horn [wailing for you].

t: תּוֹר בַּר תּוֹרֵי חַד דְּכַר חַד
e: You shall bring a burnt-offering of a pleasing aroma [accepted willingly] to [before] Adonoy, [consisting of]
one young bull, one ram,
and seven yearling lambs, [all] without blemish.
Their meal-offering [shall be] fine flour mixed with [olive] oil,
three tenths [of an eiphah] for the bull,
two tenths [of an eiphah] for the one ram,
and one tenth [of an eiphah]
for each
of the seven lambs.
[You should also bring] one he-goat as a sin-offering
to make atonement for you.

h: מִלְּבַד֩ עֹלַ֨ת הַחֹ֜דֶשׁ וּמִנְחָתָ֗הּ וְעֹלַ֤ת הַתָּמִיד֙ וּמִנְחָתָ֔הּ
t: בַּר מֵעֲלַת יַרְחָא וּמִנְחָתַהּ וַעֲלַת תְּדִירָא וּמִנְחָתַהּ
e: Aside from the [Rosh] Chodesh burnt-offering and its meal-offering, and the constant (daily) burnt-offering and its required meal-offering
and libations [appropriate for them],
for a pleasing aroma [accepted willingly],
a fire-offering to [before] Adonoy.

h: וּבֶעָשׂוֹר֩ לַחֹ֨דֶשׁ הַשְּׁבִיעִ֜י הַזֶּ֗ה מִֽקְרָא־קֹ֙דֶשׁ֙ יִהְיֶ֣ה לָכֶ֔ם
t: וּבְעַשְׂרָא לְיַרְחָא שְׁבִיעָאָה הָדֵין מְעָרַע קַדִּישׁ יְהֵי לְכוֹן
e: On the tenth day of this seventh month there shall be a sacred holiday to you,
when you shall fast
and not do any work.

t: תּוֹר בַּר תּוֹרֵי חַד דְּכַר חַד
e: You shall bring a burnt-offering [before] Adonoy, for a pleasing aroma [accepted willingly], [consisting of]
one young bull, one ram,
and seven yearling lambs.
They shall [all] be without blemish.
Their meal-offering [shall be] fine flour mixed with [olive] oil,
three tenths [of an eiphah] for the bull,
two tenths [of an eiphah]
for the one ram,
and one tenth [of an eiphah]
for each
of the seven lambs.
[You shall also bring] one he-goat as a sin-offering,
aside from the atonement sin-offering, and the constant (daily) burnt-offering
and its meal-offering, and their libations.

h: וּבַחֲמִשָּׁה֩ עָשָׂ֨ר י֜וֹם לַחֹ֣דֶשׁ הַשְּׁבִיעִ֗י מִֽקְרָא־קֹ֙דֶשׁ֙ יִהְיֶ֣ה לָכֶ֔ם
t: וּבְחַמְשַׁת עַשְׂרָא יוֹמָא לְיַרְחָא שְׁבִיעָאָה מְעָרַע קַדִּישׁ יְהֵי לְכוֹן
e: The fifteenth day of the seventh month shall be a sacred holiday to you,
when you shall not do any work of consequence.
You shall celebrate a festival to [before] Adonoy

h: וְהִקְרַבְתֶּ֨ם עֹלָ֜ה אִשֵּׁ֨ה רֵ֤יחַ נִיחֹ֙חַ֙ לַֽיהוָ֔ה
פָּרִ֧ים בְּנֵי־בָקָ֛ר שְׁלֹשָׁ֥ה עָשָׂ֖ר אֵילִ֣ם שְׁנָ֑יִם
כְּבָשִׂ֧ים בְּנֵֽי־שָׁנָ֛ה אַרְבָּעָ֥ה עָשָׂ֖ר תְּמִימִ֥ם יִהְיֽוּ׃
t: וּתְקָרְבוּן עֲלָתָא קוּרְבַּן דְּמִתְקַבֵּל בְּרַעֲוָא קֳדָם יְיָ
תּוֹרִין בְּנֵי תוֹרֵי תְּלַת עֲשַׂר דִּכְרִין תְּרֵין
אִמְּרִין בְּנֵי שְׁנָא אַרְבְּעָא עֲשַׂר שַׁלְמִין יְהוֹן:
e: You shall bring a burnt-offering, a fire-offering for a pleasing aroma [accepted willingly] to [before] Adonoy, [consisting of]
thirteen young bulls, two rams,
and fourteen yearling lambs. They shall [all] be without blemish.

h: שְׁלֹשָׁ֨ה עֶשְׂרֹנִ֜ים לַפָּ֣ר הָֽאֶחָ֗ד לִשְׁלֹשָׁ֤ה עָשָׂר֙ פָּרִ֔ים
t: תְּלָתָא עִשְׂרוֹנִין לְתוֹרָא חַד לִתְלָתָא עֲשַׂר תּוֹרִין
e: Their meal-offering [shall be] fine flour mixed with [olive] oil,
three tenths [of an eiphah] for the bull for each of the thirteen bulls,
two tenths [of an eiphah] for the ram
for each of the two rams,
and one tenth [of an eiphah]
for the lamb
for each of the fourteen lambs.
[You shall also bring] one he-goat as a sin-offering,
in addition to [bringing] the constant (daily) burnt-offering
with its meal-offering and libation.

h: וּבַיּ֣וֹם הַשֵּׁנִ֗י פָּרִ֧ים בְּנֵי־בָקָ֛ר שְׁנֵ֥ים עָשָׂ֖ר אֵילִ֣ם שְׁנָ֑יִם
t: וּבְיוֹמָא תִנְיָנָא תּוֹרִין בְּנֵי תוֹרֵי תְּרֵי עֲשַׂר דִּכְרִין תְּרֵין
אִמְּרִין בְּנֵי שְׁנָא אַרְבְּעָא עֲשַׂר שַׁלְמִין:
e: On the second day [you shall bring] twelve young bulls, two rams,
and fourteen yearling lambs, [all] without blemish,

h: וּמִנְחָתָ֣ם וְנִסְכֵּיהֶ֡ם לַ֠פָּרִים לָאֵילִ֧ם וְלַכְּבָשִׂ֛ים בְּמִסְפָּרָ֖ם כַּמִּשְׁפָּֽט׃
t: וּמִנְחַתְהוֹן וְנִסְכֵּיהוֹן לְתוֹרִין לְדִכְרִין וּלְאִמְּרִין בְּמִנְיָנֵיהוֹן כִּדְחָזֵי:
e: together with their meal-offerings and their libitions for the bulls, rams, and the lambs, of the required number.
[You shall also bring] one he-goat as a sin-offering,
in addition to [bringing] the constant (daily) burnt-offering
with its meal-offering and their libations.

h: וּבַיּ֧וֹם הַשְּׁלִישִׁ֛י פָּרִ֥ים עַשְׁתֵּי־עָשָׂ֖ר אֵילִ֣ם שְׁנָ֑יִם
t: וּבְיוֹמָא תְלִיתָאָה תּוֹרִין חַד עֲשַׂר דִּכְרִין תְּרֵין
אִמְּרִין בְּנֵי שְׁנָא אַרְבְּעָא עֲשַׂר שַׁלְמִין:
e: On the third day [you shall bring] eleven young bulls, two rams,
and fourteen yearling lambs, [all] without blemish,

h: וּמִנְחָתָ֣ם וְנִסְכֵּיהֶ֡ם לַ֠פָּרִים לָאֵילִ֧ם וְלַכְּבָשִׂ֛ים בְּמִסְפָּרָ֖ם כַּמִּשְׁפָּֽט׃
t: וּמִנְחַתְהוֹן וְנִסְכֵּיהוֹן לְתוֹרִין לְדִכְרִין וּלְאִמְּרִין בְּמִנְיָנֵיהוֹן כִּדְחָזֵי:
e: together with their meal-offerings and libations for the bulls, rams, and lambs, of the required number.
[You shall also bring] one he-goat as a sin-offering,
in addition to [bringing] the constant (daily) burnt-offering
with its meal-offering and libation.

h: וּבַיּ֧וֹם הָרְבִיעִ֛י פָּרִ֥ים עֲשָׂרָ֖ה אֵילִ֣ם שְׁנָ֑יִם
t: וּבְיוֹמָא רְבִיעָאָה תּוֹרִין עַשְׂרָא דִּכְרִין תְּרֵין
אִמְּרִין בְּנֵי שְׁנָא אַרְבְּעָא עֲשַׂר שַׁלְמִין:
e: On the fourth day [you shall bring] ten young bulls, two rams,
and fourteen yearling lambs, [all] without blemish,

h: מִנְחָתָ֣ם וְנִסְכֵּיהֶ֡ם לַ֠פָּרִים לָאֵילִ֧ם וְלַכְּבָשִׂ֛ים בְּמִסְפָּרָ֖ם כַּמִּשְׁפָּֽט׃
t: מִנְחַתְהוֹן וְנִסְכֵּיהוֹן לְתוֹרִין לְדִכְרִין וּלְאִמְּרִין בְּמִנְיָנֵיהוֹן כִּדְחָזֵי:
e: together with their meal-offerings and libations for the bulls, rams, and lambs, of the required number.
[You shall also bring] one he-goat as a sin-offering,
in addition to [bringing] the constant (daily) burnt-offering
with its meal-offering and libation.

h: וּבַיּ֧וֹם הַחֲמִישִׁ֛י פָּרִ֥ים תִּשְׁעָ֖ה אֵילִ֣ם שְׁנָ֑יִם
t: וּבְיוֹמָא חֲמִישָׁאָה תּוֹרִין תְּשַׁע דִּכְרִין תְּרֵין
אִמְּרִין בְּנֵי שְׁנָא אַרְבְּעָא עֲשַׂר שַׁלְמִין:
e: On the fifth day [you shall bring] nine young bulls, two rams,
and fourteen yearling lambs, [all] without blemish,

h: וּמִנְחָתָ֣ם וְנִסְכֵּיהֶ֡ם לַ֠פָּרִים לָאֵילִ֧ם וְלַכְּבָשִׂ֛ים בְּמִסְפָּרָ֖ם כַּמִּשְׁפָּֽט׃
t: וּמִנְחַתְהוֹן וְנִסְכֵּיהוֹן לְתוֹרִין לְדִכְרִין וּלְאִמְּרִין בְּמִנְיָנֵיהוֹן כִּדְחָזֵי:
e: together with their meal-offerings and libations for the bulls, rams, and lambs, of the required number.
[You shall also bring] one he-goat as a sin-offering,
in addition to [bringing] the constant (daily) burnt-offering
with its meal-offering and libation.

h: וּבַיּ֧וֹם הַשִּׁשִּׁ֛י פָּרִ֥ים שְׁמֹנָ֖ה אֵילִ֣ם שְׁנָ֑יִם
t: וּבְיוֹמָא שְׁתִיתָאָה תּוֹרִין תְּמַנְיָא דִּכְרִין תְּרֵין
אִמְּרִין בְּנֵי שְׁנָא אַרְבְּעָא עֲשַׂר שַׁלְמִין:
e: On the sixth day [you shall bring] eight young bulls, two rams,
and fourteen yearling lambs, [all] without blemish,

h: וּמִנְחָתָ֣ם וְנִסְכֵּיהֶ֡ם לַ֠פָּרִים לָאֵילִ֧ם וְלַכְּבָשִׂ֛ים בְּמִסְפָּרָ֖ם כַּמִּשְׁפָּֽט׃
t: וּמִנְחַתְהוֹן וְנִסְכֵּיהוֹן לְתוֹרִין לְדִכְרִין וּלְאִמְּרִין בְּמִנְיָנֵיהוֹן כִּדְחָזֵי:
e: together with their meal-offerings and libations for the bulls, rams, and lambs. of the required number.
[You shall also bring] one he-goat as a sin-offering,
in addition to [bringing] the constant (daily) burnt-offering
with its meal-offering and libations.

h: וּבַיּ֧וֹם הַשְּׁבִיעִ֛י פָּרִ֥ים שִׁבְעָ֖ה אֵילִ֣ם שְׁנָ֑יִם
t: וּבְיוֹמָא שְׁבִיעָאָה תּוֹרִין שַׁבְעָא דִּכְרִין תְּרֵין
אִמְּרִין בְּנֵי שְׁנָא אַרְבְּעָא עֲשַׂר שַׁלְמִין:
e: On the seventh day [you shall bring] seven young bulls, two rams,
and fourteen yearling lambs, [all] without blemish,

h: וּמִנְחָתָ֣ם וְנִסְכֵּהֶ֡ם לַ֠פָּרִים לָאֵילִ֧ם וְלַכְּבָשִׂ֛ים בְּמִסְפָּרָ֖ם כְּמִשְׁפָּטָֽם׃
t: וּמִנְחַתְהוֹן וְנִסְכֵּיהוֹן לְתוֹרִין לְדִכְרִין וּלְאִמְּרִין בְּמִנְיָנֵיהוֹן כִּדְחָזֵי לְהוֹן:
e: together with their meal-offerings and libations for the bulls, rams, and lambs. of their required number.
[You shall also bring] one he-goat as a sin-offering,
in addition to [bringing] the constant (daily) burnt-offering
with its meal-offering and libation.
On the eighth day
shall be a [day of] restraint [assembly] for you,
when you shall not do any work of consequence.

h: וְהִקְרַבְתֶּ֨ם עֹלָ֜ה אִשֵּׁ֨ה רֵ֤יחַ נִיחֹ֙חַ֙ לַֽיהוָ֔ה
t: וּתְקָרְבוּן עֲלָתָא קוּרְבַּן דְּמִתְקַבַּל בְּרַעֲוָא קֳדָם יְיָ
e: You shall bring a burnt-offering, a fire-offering for a pleasing aroma [accepted willingly] to [before] Adonoy,
[consisting of] one young bull, one ram,
and seven yearling lambs, [all] without blemish;

h: מִנְחָתָ֣ם וְנִסְכֵּיהֶ֗ם לַפָּ֨ר לָאַ֧יִל וְלַכְּבָשִׂ֛ים בְּמִסְפָּרָ֖ם כַּמִּשְׁפָּֽט׃
t: מִנְחַתְהוֹן וְנִסְכֵּיהוֹן לְתוֹרָא לְדִכְרָא וּלְאִמְּרִין בְּמִנְיָנֵיהוֹן כִּדְחָזֵי:
e: [together with] their meal-offerings and libations for the bull, ram, and lambs. of the required number.
And one he-goat as a sin-offering,
in addition to [bringing] the constant (daily) burnt-offering
with its meal-offering and libation.
These you shall make to Adonoy on your festivals,
aside from your vows and dedications, burnt-offerings and meal-offerings,
and libations and peace-offerings.”

t: כְּכֹל דִּי פַקִּיד יְיָ יָת משֶׁה:
e: Moshe spoke to Bnei Yisroel
all that Adonoy had commanded him.
